text:
Selena T.: Hey team — quick sync on the "safety lane" fallback UX. thinking to expose three degrade modes in console: quiet, gentle, full. What triggers should map to each?

Matt R.: agree. quiet = sampling only, no operator notif. gentle = ramped fallback + notify on repeats. full = immediate switch to fallback variant.

Anya P.: For triggers i'd say: latency spike > p95 threshold -> gentle; repeated 5xx > N in M minutes -> full; transient 502s -> quiet sampling.

Kevin L.: How do we show audit trail? need trace id, decision reason, input hash, prev and fallback model id. retention 30d by default.

Selena T.: +1. Also need sampling rate UI per route. default 1% for quiet, 10% for gentle. Operators should be able to override per-customer.

Matt R.: UX question — should we show raw counts or normalized rates? normalized is easier for ops.

Anya P.: Also include "why did we pick this" human-friendly reason. e.g., "latency p95 2.4s > 2s" not just code.

Kevin L.: telemetry-wise emit event: fallback_decision {reason, mode, route, policy_version, sample_seed}. Keep schema small.

Selena T.: here's a quick policy snippet for console preview:

```json
{
  "policy_version":"2026-03-20",
  "route":"/v1/generate",
  "modes":[
    {"name":"quiet","sampling":0.01,"triggers":[{"type":"error","match":"5xx","count":1,"window_s":"60"}]},
    {"name":"gentle","sampling":0.1,"triggers":[{"type":"latency","p95_ms":2000}]},
    {"name":"full","triggers":[{"type":"error","match":"5xx","count":5,"window_s":"300"}]}
  ],
  "operator_override":true
}
```

Matt R.: love that. small nit: window_s should be window_s:300 not string.

deploy-bot: policy preview updated in staging for route /v1/generate — link: https://staging.console.redwood/policies/preview/1711122334

Anya P.: We should also add a "replayable decision payload" link in audit log that feeds sim.

Kevin L.: retention and export: allow CSV and JSONL downloads, and wire to kafka topic fallback.decisions.

Selena T.: next step: design mockups midweek. @Matt R. can you add normalized-rate graphs to the route page? @Kevin L. add telemetry schema PR.

Matt R.: yep I'll mock late Tue.

Kevin L.: will open PR Thurs.

Selena T.: thanks all :rocket:
